content.text: {"core": "Plurality holds many things at once — every angle, every version, all the ways a thing could be read. In Wisdom, it works on the quiet inner knowing that settles before words arrive. Left unnamed, the many readings run in the dark: the knowing keeps splitting into more possibilities than it can close, and the crowd of maybes drowns out the one thing already known.", "sheetLine": "The knowing is there; too many unspoken versions are burying it."}
